_about: Door deaths in Son Ocaq (STORY_BIBLE §6: opening the door to a shade kills the one who opens). Off-screen, never in front of the player. Rules: scripts/hub/hub_nights.gd. Nights are counted in the hub only, per NPC. From warning_night (default 1) on, while warning_if holds ("" = always), the NPC is WARNED: their night line is HUB_WARNING_<ID> and their lost one's shade knocks at their door. FAIRNESS: the death countdown starts only once the warning was HEARD (the line at the door, or "warning_heard:<npc>" from a story line such as Domrul's line 3); unheard, it repeats the next hub night. The death resolves only while Aras waits at the hearth until morning, on a hub night after the heard one, if death_if holds ("" = always). cancel_if ends the warning for good. Sona's and Domrul's conditions are PLACEHOLDER flags until the story writes them.

events._about: STORY_SLICE §S10: night 1 normal talk, night 2 the warning; the next hub night after it is heard, he opens the door — unless his grief is resolved (the yazma).
